snippet.title: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon Expansion | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon Expansion is coming this summer to PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and mobile platforms!

In ancient times, Saint Baal'Thasar had a vision of paradise, lit by a bright, red moon. And so he founded the Order of the Red Moon, to lead people to a land of eternal life. The myth says that Baal'Thasar found his paradise during a pilgrimage, and so never returned.

12 new characters
16+ new weapons and evolutions
1 new XL stage 
8 new music tracks
& more!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4781330/Vampire_Survivors_Legacy_of_the_Bloodmoon

🔗 https://beacons.ai/poncle
